findings.evidence: In `pkg/ddl/backfilling_read_index.go`, `(*readIndexExecutor).RunSubtask` builds a per-subtask `BackendCtx` using a shared `*local.Backend` (`Build(r.backendCfg, r.backend)`), then immediately returns on `buildLocalStorePipeline` error without any engine cleanup (`FinishAndUnregisterEngines` is only called after `executeAndClosePipeline`). `buildLocalStorePipeline` calls `backendCtx.Register(...)` before calling `NewAddIndexIngestPipeline(...)`, which can fail (it returns errors from `NewReorgCopContext`, e.g. timezone load errors via `reorgTimeZoneWithTzLoc`). With this PR, `litBackendCtx.Close()` in `pkg/ddl/ingest/backend.go` no longer closes the backend, so an early-return after `Register` leaves engines open inside the reused backend across retries/subtasks. Lightning local backend engine open is not re-entrant: `pkg/lightning/backend/local/engine_mgr.go` `openEngine()` calls `pebble.Open()` on the engine DB path and `LoadOrStore`, so a second `OpenEngine` on the same UUID before cleanup will typically hit Pebble lock errors (and/or risks duplicated ingest loops if it were to proceed).
findings.fix: In DXF local-sort path, ensure cleanup runs on *all* error exits after engine registration when reusing a backend. Minimal fix: after `buildLocalStorePipeline` returns error, call `bCtx.FinishAndUnregisterEngines(ingest.OptCleanData)` (or at least `OptCloseEngines`) before returning. More robust: track whether `Register` succeeded and `defer` a cleanup-on-error; alternatively reset/close and recreate the shared backend on subtask failure to guarantee a clean slate for retries.
findings.impact: A transient/fatal error during pipeline construction after `Register` can leave engines and Pebble DBs open in the shared backend. Subsequent retries/subtasks on the same executor may fail opening engines due to file locks, wedge the DXF add-index step, leak goroutines/FDs until step cleanup, and in worst cases risk inconsistent engine state if repeated opens were to proceed.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `pingcap/master@bab4993b6f`: `pkg/ddl/backfilling_read_index.go` still returns immediately on local pipeline build error without calling `FinishAndUnregisterEngines`, and `pkg/ddl/ingest/backend.go` `litBackendCtx.Close()` still does not close the backend; no later fix found for this error-path cleanup gap.
findings.verify: Inject a failure after `backendCtx.Register` / during `NewReorgCopContext` (e.g. failpoint or invalid TZ to force `time.LoadLocation` error) in DXF local-sort add-index, then observe executor retry behavior: next `RunSubtask` should be able to `Register` without Pebble lock errors, and local sort dir/engines should be cleaned (`FinishAndUnregisterEngines(OptCleanData)` runs) before retry continues.
findings.what: DXF local-sort read-index step can leak open engines on early errors: with backend reuse and `BackendCtx.Close()` no longer closing the backend, a `buildLocalStorePipeline` failure after `Register` returns without engine cleanup, leaving engines open in the shared `*local.Backend` and breaking subsequent retries/subtasks (Pebble lock/open-engine failures, potential step wedging).

subject: ddl: reuse backend for DXF subtasks of same step (#59165)
summary: Found one High issue: in DXF local-sort read-index executor, backend reuse + `BackendCtx.Close()` no longer closing the backend introduces an error-path engine leak (after `Register` but before `FinishAndUnregisterEngines`), which can wedge retries/subtasks via local engine (Pebble) reopen/lock behavior. Not fixed up to `pingcap/master@bab4993b6f`.
